label: 📤 Unpack struct
description: Explode a struct column into one column per field. Inverse of pack_struct.

fields.label: Field names to extract
fields.help: Names of the struct fields to pull out as separate columns. The original struct column is dropped from the output.

outputPrefix.label: Output column prefix
outputPrefix.help: Optional. Prepended to each generated column name to avoid collisions with existing columns.
